e57_read — FILEIO e57 op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.e57_read(data) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.e57_read(data); from the registry, opsfileio.get("e57_read"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Read ASTM E57 bytes and return a point-cloud table with coordinates, intensity, color, and pose.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

この op は 1 scan の E57 を受け付ける。pye57 未導入時は黙って代替せず導入コマンドを含む ImportError を返す。呼び出し例: table = e57_read(payload)。
